transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hello, Sarah. I'm calling about a billing issue on my corporate account. I seem to be getting charged sales tax when I shouldn't be.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that for you. To access your account, I'll need to verify your information. Could you please provide me with your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's CUST-1028.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And for security purposes, could you please provide the 4-digit security PIN associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The PIN is 6-3-9-5.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. Let me just pull up your account details... One moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I have the account for David Lewis. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, Mr. Lewis. Thank you for verifying. So, you mentioned you're being charged sales tax on your account, but you believe it should be tax-exempt?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's correct. I submitted our company's state tax-exempt certificate through your online portal about three months ago. I expected the taxes to be removed, but they're still on every bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand. I apologize for that inconvenience. Let me take a look at your account's document history and billing statements to see what's going on.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm looking at your file now... Yes, I do see a document uploaded on... let's see... August 14th. It's labeled 'Tax Exempt Cert'. Is that the one?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, August 14th sounds right. That was right after we opened the account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, and now I'm checking your invoices for September, October, and November. I can see the base charge for your Unlimited 5G plan at $65, and then... yes, there's a 'State and Local Sales Tax' line item on each one.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Exactly. So the document was received, but it seems it was never applied to the billing account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It appears that way, and I do apologize for that oversight. It looks like the document was successfully uploaded to your file but the final step to flag the account itself as tax-exempt in our billing system was missed. I can correct that for you right now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, good. And what about the taxes I've already paid for the last three months? I'll need those refunded.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. We will definitely credit your account for the amount that was incorrectly charged. Let me calculate that for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Please do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just one moment while I pull the exact figures from each invoice...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I have it. On your September, October, and November invoices, you were charged $4.55 in state sales tax each month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Four fifty-five. Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, for the three months, that comes to a total of $13.65. We will apply a credit for that full amount back to your Cymbal Telecom account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, $13.65. And you're sure the account will be fixed going forward?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. The process involves two steps on my end. First, I need to submit a form to our back-office billing team to permanently apply the tax-exempt status to your account profile. Second, I will process the credit for the $13.65.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And how long does that take?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can complete both actions for you right now on this call. It will require me to use a couple of different tools, so I may need to place you on a brief hold if that's okay?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's fine. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Lewis. I'll be back with you in just a moment. Please hold.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Mr. Lewis? Thank you for holding. I'm starting with the tax status update first.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm just filling out the required information... I have the certificate ID from your file... and I'm attaching it to the profile update request.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And I'm setting the effective date to today, so this will be corrected for all future billing cycles. Submitting that now... and... done. I have a confirmation number for that request. It's now in the queue to be finalized.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What does 'in the queue' mean? Is it not immediate?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's a great question. The system processes these requests in batches overnight. So while I've submitted it and it's been accepted, the actual status change in the core billing system will be reflected within 24 hours. But it is guaranteed to be in effect before your next bill is generated.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I see. As long as I don't see tax on my December bill, that's fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will not. I can assure you of that. Now, for the second part, which is applying the credit. This is a separate tool, so let me just switch over.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I'm in the account credit module. I'm selecting a 'Billing Error Adjustment' as the reason.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sounds right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the amount is... thirteen dollars and sixty-five cents.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm adding a note here: 'Credit for state sales tax charged in error for Sept, Oct, Nov 2023. Account is now updated to tax-exempt status.' This is for our records.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Good, that's clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I'm about to submit this credit. This one should reflect on your account almost immediately. It may take a few minutes for the online portal to update, but it will be there. Submitting now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hmm. The system is giving me a validation error.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: An error? What does that mean?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me read it. It says 'Credit amount exceeds single-period tax charges. Supervisor approval required.' This is a standard security measure to prevent large, erroneous credits. Since the $13.65 covers three billing periods, it's triggering this flag.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So you can't process the refund?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can, I just need to get a supervisor's digital approval to override the flag. They're all equipped to do this remotely. Would you mind holding for another two to three minutes while I ping my supervisor and have them approve this request for me?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, this is getting a bit complicated, but if that's what it takes. Please go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand, and I appreciate your patience, Mr. Lewis. This is just a protective measure in our system. I'll get this sorted out right away. Please hold.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Mr. Lewis, thank you so much for your patience. I apologize for the long wait, my supervisor was assisting another agent but I have the approval now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem. Were you able to process it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. With the override in place, I was able to resubmit the credit request, and it has been successfully processed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so it's done?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, sir. I have a confirmation ID for the credit as well. The amount of $13.65 is now posted to your Cymbal Telecom account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And how will I see this credit?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It will appear on your next invoice as a line item, likely labeled 'Account Adjustment' or 'Courtesy Credit'. It will reduce the total amount due on that bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So my next bill will be for $65 minus $13.65?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is exactly correct. Your total due will be $51.35, plus any applicable fees, though your plan doesn't have many of those. And of course, there will be no sales tax.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. That's what I needed to hear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am very glad we could get this sorted out for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Can you give me a reference number for this call? Just for my records.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. Your reference number for today's interaction is 8-4-7-2-9-1-B. That's 'B' as in 'Billing'.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, got it. 847291B.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. So, to recap: We've successfully submitted the request to have your account permanently marked as tax-exempt, which will take effect within 24 hours. And we have applied a credit of $13.65 to your account for the taxes previously paid in error.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's a good summary. Thank you for your help, Sarah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome, Mr. Lewis. I'm happy I could resolve this for you today. Is there anything else I can assist you with? Perhaps any questions about your plan or other Cymbal services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was the only issue. I'm all set.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you for your call and for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too, Mr. Lewis. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Goodbye.
